summary: Beyond Meat filed an 8-K disclosing the effectiveness of a 1-for-30 reverse stock split and authorized share reduction, effective August 13, 2026. The board previously approved the ratio, and the Charter Amendment was filed with Delaware. Every 30 shares became 1 share, with fractional shares rounded up. The stock began trading split-adjusted on August 14 under BYND with a new CUSIP. This corporate action reduces share count and boosts per-share price, likely to meet listing requirements. Watch for potential Nasdaq compliance and any future capital actions.
